name: Christine de Pizan
shortBio: Late medieval Venetian-French philosopher and political writer who inaugurated Europe's Querelle des Femmes in The Book of the City of Ladies, refuting scholastic misogyny through rational equality and civic virtue.
centralQuestion: If moral capacity and intellect are not determined by bodily sex, why do authoritative literary and philosophical canons construct women as inferior by nature?

keyWorks.title: The Book of the City of Ladies
keyWorks.description: Allegorical philosophical defense of women's rational, civic, and moral equality guided by Lady Reason, Lady Rectitude, and Lady Justice.

keyWorks.title: The Book of the Body Politic
keyWorks.description: Political treatise outlining mutual civic obligations across rulers, nobles, and commoners.
